title: How P&G Supports Women’s Health and Longevity | P&G
summary: Discover how P&G supports women’s health and longevity through science-backed brand innovation, expert insights and partnerships focused on healthy aging.
body_markdown:
Oral health plays an important role in overall well-being, and healthy daily habits can have benefits beyond the mouth. **Crest** and **Oral-B** help support those routines with innovations designed to make oral care effective and accessible. **Crest Pro-Health toothpaste** uses stabilized stannous fluoride to help provide antibacterial protection with twice-daily brushing, while **Oral-B iO electric toothbrushes** are designed to remove more plaque than a manual toothbrush.


Research continues to highlight the role of fiber in supporting overall wellness, including digestive health, heart health, and healthy blood sugar levels as we age. Metamucil, made with psyllium fiber, makes it easy to add more fiber to a daily routine — one simple habit with multiple health benefits that contribute to long-term well-being.


As women age, many experience changes in hair thickness, density, and strength. Pantene combines decades of hair science with innovations designed to meet these evolving needs. The Pantene Abundant & Strong collection is formulated to help strengthen hair and reduce breakage, supporting healthier-looking hair so women can feel more confident.
